of.needed: whether the ApplicationSet has one or more nested selectors (exact field paths not stated in the excerpt)

consequence.statement: Nested selectors that were previously not applied (applyNestedSelectors unset or false) are now always applied, which changes which applications the ApplicationSet generates.
consequence.remediation: Before upgrading, remove nested selectors from ApplicationSets where applyNestedSelectors was not explicitly true; search controller logs for 'ignoring nested selector' to detect impact.

assertion.statement: Starting in Argo CD 3.0 the ApplicationSet spec.applyNestedSelectors field is ignored and nested selectors are always applied (as if true), so ApplicationSets with nested selectors and the field unset/false will change behavior.
